svg.title: Doran Vex Amaranthine, Ledger-Warden of the Foreknowledge Archive

text.tspan: Doran Vex Amaranthine, Ledger-Warden of the Foreknowledge Archive
Fast. When this resolves, look at the top card
of an opponent's Archive; then put it back.
Doran Vex Amaranthine keeps The Panoptic
anything which will happen has already left a
trace of itself, for whoever is patient enough
